input.rationale: Section 9 ("Warranties") contains only mutual representations as to corporate existence, authority, enforceability and non-conflict (p0056-p0057) plus a Globix carve-out (p0058). There is no express performance warranty from HDI covering the design, development, hosting, operation and maintenance of the Site, no conformance warranty for the Site or software, no compliance-with-law or malicious-code warranty, and no repair/re-performance/refund remedy. (There is also no disclaimer, so nothing swallows an express warranty.) Under the playbook this absence is a deviation requiring insertion; we added a new Section 9(c) with workmanlike services, a 12-month conformance period for the Site/software, legal compliance and no malicious code, with a re-performance, repair/replacement or refund remedy, and flagged the 90-day/30-day fallback.

proposal.summary: Add an HDI performance warranty (workmanlike services, 12-month conformance for the Site/software, legal compliance, no malicious code) with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual corporate authority representations, so HDI gives no warranty at all for the development, hosting and maintenance work it is performing. We have added a standard performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services, 12-month conformance of the Site and software to specifications, compliance with law, no malicious code) with a re-performance, repair/replacement or refund remedy; if 12 months is too long we can accept 90 days for software and 30 days for services with the same remedies.

ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the services performed by HDI under this Agreement, including the design, development, implementation, hosting, operation, maintenance and management of the Site, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with applicable industry standards; (2) for a period of twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, the Site and any software or other deliverables provided by HDI hereunder will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation therefor and to the requirements of this Agreement; (3) HDI's performance of this Agreement will comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and such software and other deliverables will be free of any viruses, disabling devices or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, re-performance of the non-conforming services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or deliverable, or a refund of the fees paid with respect to the non-conforming services, software or deliverable.
